headingEmphasis: with years of experience in workplace therapy.
paragraph1: I'm Kelly Marie, a BACP-registered psychotherapist. I've spent years working with individuals, couples, young people and organisations, and I care a lot about getting people to talk openly about mental health.
paragraph2: My practice is grounded in psychodynamic theory, which looks at how early relationships and unconscious patterns shape the way we feel now. I also draw on integrative and trauma-informed approaches, and I fit the work around what you need.
paragraph3: I specialise in workplace therapy. When an organisation contracts me, I work closely with HR and managers so that staff who could benefit from therapy are referred quickly and get the right support.
